title: Welcome to r/SILTNutrition: who we are, what's in every stick, and how to reach us
text:
Hi, I'm Abhishek, founder of SILT Nutrition. This is our official community. Ask questions here, share honest reviews (the bad ones too), and get answers from the team directly.

What SILT is: two drink mixes in stick packs for busy professionals. Sixty seconds, twice a day.

SILT Mornings (Lemon Orange): 80 mg caffeine + 200 mg L-theanine for steady energy, 5 g PHGG fibre + 6 billion probiotics for gut health, and D3, K2, B12 and C at 100% RDA.

SILT Nights (Chamomile Lemon): 3 g glycine for falling asleep, 250 mg magnesium from bisglycinate for recovery, 300 mg KSM-66 ashwagandha root + 200 mg L-theanine for stress.

No added sugar, no proprietary blends, every dose on the pack. Each of the 19 ingredients has a lab report you can read on siltnutrition.com.

Who should check with a doctor first: if you're pregnant or nursing, on regular medication, have a medical condition, or are sensitive to caffeine. SILT isn't meant to treat insomnia, deficiencies or any disease.

How this sub works: be honest, be kind, and no medical advice. I read everything posted here, and we aim to reply within a day.

To start us off: what made you curious about SILT, and what would you like us to explain better?
